mapper.sql: account_id id, account_type type, email_vault_token emailToken, email_masked emailMasked, status, consecutive_password_failures failures, locked_until lockedUntil, credential_version credentialVersion, auth_epoch authEpoch, version

session_id id, account_id accountId, context_type contextType, tenant_id tenantId, tenant_member_id memberId, account_auth_epoch accountEpoch, credential_version_snapshot credentialVersion, issued_time issuedTime, last_activity_time lastActivityTime, idle_expire_time idleExpireTime, absolute_expire_time absoluteExpireTime, current_generation_no generationNo, status
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_user_account WHERE realm='OPERATIONS' AND account_id=#{id}

SELECT FROM t_user_account WHERE realm='OPERATIONS' AND ((#{bootstrap}=1 AND account_type='BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN' AND login_name='admin' AND email_vault_token IS NULL AND email_masked IS NULL AND email_verified_time IS NULL) OR (#{bootstrap}=0 AND account_type='HUMAN' AND login_name IS NULL AND email_vault_token=#{token} AND email_masked IS NOT NULL))
SELECT FROM t_user_account WHERE account_id=#{id} AND realm='OPERATIONS' AND account_type='BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN' FOR UPDATE
SELECT account_id FROM t_user_account WHERE account_id=#{id} AND realm='OPERATIONS' FOR SHARE

SELECT m.member_id FROM t_tenant_member m WHERE m.member_id=( SELECT scoped.member_id FROM t_tenant_member scoped JOIN t_access_tenant t ON t.tenant_id=scoped.tenant_id AND t.tenant_type='INTERNAL' AND t.owner_ref_id=1 JOIN t_user_account a ON a.account_id=scoped.account_id AND a.realm='OPERATIONS' WHERE scoped.account_id=#{accountId} ) FOR SHARE
SELECT tenant_id FROM t_access_tenant WHERE tenant_type='INTERNAL' AND owner_ref_id=1 AND owner_status='ACTIVE' AND security_status='ACTIVE'

SELECT password_credential_id id, account_id accountId, password_verifier_phc verifier, algorithm_version algorithmVersion, memory_kib memoryKib, iterations, parallelism, credential_version credentialVersion, force_change_flag forceChange, status FROM t_password_credential WHERE account_id=#{id} AND algorithm_code='ARGON2ID'

SELECT m.member_id id, m.tenant_id tenantId, m.account_id accountId, m.status, t.owner_status ownerStatus, t.security_status securityStatus, m.version FROM t_tenant_member m JOIN t_access_tenant t ON t.tenant_id=m.tenant_id WHERE m.account_id=#{id} AND t.tenant_type='INTERNAL' AND t.owner_ref_id=1
SELECT FROM t_auth_session WHERE session_id=#{id} AND realm='OPERATIONS' AND channel='OPERATIONS' AND authentication_method='PASSWORD'
SELECT FROM t_auth_session WHERE session_id=#{id} AND realm='OPERATIONS' AND channel='OPERATIONS' AND authentication_method='PASSWORD' FOR UPDATE

SELECT refresh_generation_id id, session_id sessionId, generation_no generationNo, token_lookup_id lookupId, token_secret_hmac secretHmac, hmac_key_version keyVersion, status, expires_time expiresTime FROM t_refresh_token_generation WHERE token_lookup_id=#{lookupId}
SELECT signing_key_id id, kid, kms_key_ref keyRef, public_jwk_canonical_json publicJwk, not_before notBefore FROM t_jwt_signing_key WHERE realm='OPERATIONS' AND status='ACTIVE' AND active_slot=1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_auth_session(session_id, account_id, realm, channel, context_type, tenant_id, tenant_member_id, authentication_method, account_auth_epoch, credential_version_snapshot, issued_time, last_reauthenticated_time, last_activity_time, idle_expire_time, absolute_expire_time, current_generation_no, status, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{id}, #{accountId}, 'OPERATIONS', 'OPERATIONS', #{contextType}, #{tenantId}, #{memberId}, 'PASSWORD', #{accountEpoch}, #{credentialVersion}, #{issuedTime}, #{issuedTime}, #{lastActivityTime}, #{idleExpireTime}, #{absoluteExpireTime}, #{generationNo}, #{status}, 1, #{issuedTime}, #{issuedTime})

INSERT INTO t_refresh_token_generation(refresh_generation_id, session_id, generation_no, token_lookup_id, token_secret_hmac, hmac_key_version, issued_time, expires_time, status, active_slot, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.id}, #{row.sessionId}, #{row.generationNo}, #{row.lookupId}, #{row.secretHmac}, #{row.keyVersion}, #{now}, #{row.expiresTime}, 'ISSUED', 1, 1, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_refresh_token_generation SET replaced_by_generation_id=#{nextId}, version=version+1 WHERE refresh_generation_id=#{id} AND status='CONSUMED' AND active_slot IS NULL AND replaced_by_generation_id IS NULL

UPDATE t_auth_session SET status=#{status}, revocation_reason=#{reason}, revoked_time=#{now}, version=version+1, update_time=#{now} WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND realm='OPERATIONS' AND channel='OPERATIONS' AND authentication_method='PASSWORD' AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_account(account_id, realm, account_type, email_vault_token, email_masked, status, consecutive_password_failures, credential_version, auth_epoch, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{id}, 'OPERATIONS', 'HUMAN', #{token}, #{masked}, 'ACTIVE', 0, 1, 1, 1, #{now}, #{now})

INSERT INTO t_password_credential(password_credential_id, account_id, password_verifier_phc, algorithm_code, algorithm_version, memory_kib, iterations, parallelism, credential_version, force_change_flag, status, password_changed_time, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{id}, #{accountId}, #{verifier}, 'ARGON2ID', 19, 19456, 2, 1, 1, 1, 'ACTIVE', #{now}, 1, #{now}, #{now})
INSERT INTO t_tenant_member(member_id, tenant_id, account_id, member_type, status, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{accountId}, 'MEMBER', 'ACTIVE', 1, #{now}, #{now})
